templates.title: Grades updated
templates.subject: Grades updated in Infinite Campus
templates.body: Your grades have been updated and synced to Infinite Campus. Please allow approximately one hour for changes to appear.

templates.title: Assignment graded
templates.subject: {{assignmentName}} has been graded
templates.body: I finished grading {{assignmentName}}, and your score is now in Infinite Campus. Let me know if you have any questions about it.

templates.title: Looking into your grade
templates.subject: Re: Your grade in {{course}}
templates.body: Thanks for asking about your grade. I'll take a look and get back to you by {{date}}. In the meantime, you can see the score for each assignment in Infinite Campus.

templates.title: Test correction dates
templates.subject: Test corrections: {{startDate}} to {{endDate}}
templates.body: Test corrections begin on {{startDate}} and end on {{endDate}}. Please come during that time to improve your grade.

templates.title: How test corrections work
templates.subject: How test corrections work
templates.body: To do test corrections, come to my room during the correction window and bring your test. For each question you missed, explain the mistake and show the correct work. Corrections need to be finished by {{endDate}}.

templates.title: Missing work reminder
templates.subject: Missing work in {{course}}
templates.body: Please submit any missing assignments before the deadline listed in Infinite Campus.

templates.title: Missing a specific assignment
templates.subject: Missing: {{assignmentName}}
templates.body: I don't have {{assignmentName}} from you yet. Please turn it in by {{date}} so you can get credit for it. If you already turned it in, reply to this email and let me know where.

templates.title: Late work received
templates.subject: Re: Late assignment
templates.body: Thank you for submitting your assignment. I will review it and update the grade as soon as possible.

templates.title: Retake approved
templates.subject: Retake for {{assignmentName}}
templates.body: Yes, you can retake {{assignmentName}}. The retake is on {{date}}. Please review your notes and your corrected test before then.

templates.title: Retake policy
templates.subject: Re: Retakes
templates.body: Retakes are available once you finish your test corrections. When your corrections are done, email me and we'll set up a time for the retake. Your higher score is the one that counts.

templates.title: Missing work update for parents
templates.subject: Update on {{studentName}} in {{course}}
templates.body: I'm reaching out with a quick update on {{studentName}} in {{course}}. {{studentName}} is currently missing {{assignmentName}}. Turning it in by {{date}} would really help their grade. Please let me know if you have any questions.

templates.title: Thanks for reaching out
templates.subject: Re: {{studentName}}
templates.body: Thank you for reaching out about {{studentName}}. I'm looking into it and will get back to you by {{date}}.

templates.title: Conference request
templates.subject: Meeting about {{studentName}}
templates.body: I'd like to set up a time to talk about how {{studentName}} is doing in {{course}}. Would {{date}} work for a quick call or meeting? If not, just send me a few times that work for you.

templates.title: Work missed while absent
templates.subject: What you missed on {{date}}
templates.body: Sorry you were out on {{date}}. The notes and assignments from that day are posted online. Please make up the missed work within a few days, and come see me if anything doesn't make sense.

templates.title: Checking in on absences
templates.subject: Checking in on {{studentName}}
templates.body: I noticed {{studentName}} has missed a few classes recently, most recently on {{date}}. I wanted to check in and make sure everything is okay, and to let you know I'm happy to help them catch up.

templates.title: Got it, thanks
templates.subject: Re: Your email
templates.body: Thanks for your email! I got it and will get back to you soon.

templates.title: Come see me
templates.subject: Re: Your question
templates.body: Great question. It's easier to explain in person, so please stop by my room before or after school and I'll walk you through it.

templates.title: Extension approved
templates.subject: Extension for {{assignmentName}}
templates.body: You can have an extension on {{assignmentName}}. Your new due date is {{date}}.
